gold_verdict: unclear, close to the band's rate; agrees with the model that this is high risk
candidate_verdict: real risk; agrees with the model

key_points.point: Verdict unclear (not clearly above band rate), own risk high ~15%, agrees with model's high score because November 2024 insider-backed refinancing pushed nearly all debt to 2028

Short cash runway: $21.1M cash lasts ~4.7 months at average $4.5M/month burn, ~2.7 months at Q4's $7.9M/month (roughly the filing date); January 2025 voluntary flight cancellations for maintenance made it worse

Losses are cash losses: reported loss fell 70% but cash-adjusted loss fell only 31% ($89.2M to $61.3M); a $32.3M stock-comp reversal made Q4 show +$1.3M net income while Q4 really lost ~$31M and Q4 burn was the year's worst
Leverage: liabilities ~197% of assets (2nd highest of peers), equity -$120.0M vs -$77.5M, current ratio 0.38 vs peer median 0.78
Defaults and going-concern doubt: $7.7M IRS excise tax, $1.6M property tax, $0.5M note unpaid since 2019; substantial doubt in Note 1 and auditor report
Limited equity access: GEM facility restricted by daily volume limits and requires NYSE listing; company below NYSE standards since May 2024
Evidence against: debt runs to 2028 (only $2.5M due 2025; Comvest interest-only to Nov 2028 with delayed-draw line for interest; $50M LamVen and $8M PFG notes to Dec 2028)
Evidence against: insiders keep funding ($34.5M in 2024, $22.5M in 2023) and the Comvest loan is backstopped by an HSBC letter of credit arranged by related party Park Lane
Evidence against: in compliance with all loan covenants at December 31, 2024
Evidence against: revenue doubled (partly Essential Air Service subsidy) and an S-3 shelf filed 2025-02-11

contradictions: Non-cash share of the 2024 loss: CANDIDATE says only about 3% is non-cash (cash-adjusted loss -$72.5M, stock comp a $6.0M net reversal), while GOLD says 18% is non-cash (adjusted loss -$61.3M) and highlights a $32.3M stock-comp reversal
NYSE cure period end: CANDIDATE says about February 2026, GOLD says about 20 November 2025
Revenue peer rank: CANDIDATE puts revenue at the 73rd percentile of peers, GOLD says revenue is smaller than 88% of peers
Cash at 30 September 2024: CANDIDATE says about $1.1M, GOLD says $0.5M
extra_points_in_candidate: Cross-collateralized financing agreements create cross-default/acceleration risk
PFG waiver of the $10 million minimum cash covenant was needed through December 31, 2024
IRS offer-in-compromise pauses excise tax collection while the company pays $34 thousand a month
County property-tax lien on four aircraft
Debt principal rose from $52.1M to $122.6M; financing inflows of $77.2M covered the $54.3M burn
NYSE $1.00 price compliance regained, GEM restored and 1-for-7 reverse split in August 2024
$818 thousand PFG interest in arrears at September 30, 2024 listed as a current default
summary: CANDIDATE agrees with GOLD on high risk, leverage, defaults, going-concern doubt and the 2028 refinancing, but calls it real risk at ~22% where GOLD sees an unclear case at ~15%. It misses GOLD's key insight that a $32.3M stock-comp reversal flattered Q4 and the January 2025 cancellations, omits year-end covenant compliance, and contradicts GOLD on the non-cash share of the loss and the NYSE cure date.
